Purpose: Runs the guardrails/ test suite (checkRemediationGuardrail + AuditLog) to prove human-approval and audit-logging behavior actually works.
Example Usage: const result = await runGuardrailTests(); if (!result.ok) console.error(result.summary);

Purpose: Runs the mcp-server/ test suite (DMV reader, reliability wrapper, read-only guard).
Type-checks both TypeScript packages (guardrails/ and mcp-server/) with tsc --noEmit.
Example Usage: const { ok, results } = await typeCheckAll(); results.forEach(r => console.log(r.package, r.ok));

Purpose: Reads .colaberry/progress.json and reports one story's verification status and per-criterion pass/fail.
Lists every story in .colaberry/plan.json whose verification.state is not "verified" yet.
Example Usage: const pending = listUnverifiedStories(); pending.forEach(s => console.log(s.id, s.state));

Purpose: Runs guardrails/demoUnsafeAction.ts, showing a valid, evidence-linked remediation still blocked for lack of human approval.
Starts the Command Center dashboard as a background static file server, without blocking the terminal.
Example Usage: const { pid, url } = startCommandCenter(); console.log(url, pid);

Purpose: Reports current git status (uncommitted files) and the last commit, as a pre-commit sanity check.
